map.循经感传是什么？: What is propagated sensation along the meridian?
map.针刺或按压时酸麻胀感沿经脉路线传导的现象，是经气运行的可感知表现，存在个体差异。: It is the phenomenon in which soreness, numbness and distension during needling or pressure travel along the meridian route; it is a perceptible expression of the movement of meridian qi and varies between individuals.
map.经络有解剖实体吗？: Do the meridians have an anatomical entity?
map.经络是中医对人体联络系统的功能概括，现代研究有多种假说，尚未对应单一解剖结构；本: The meridians are the TCM functional generalization of the body's connecting system; modern research offers several hypotheses, and no single anatomical structure has been matched to them. This tool is for study reference.
